question: dame los diez motivos de rechazo más frecuentes, cada uno con su número de intentos rechazados
sql: SELECT ref_decline_reason.description, count(*) FROM fact_payment_attempt JOIN ref_decline_reason ON fact_payment_attempt.decline_reason_code = ref_decline_reason.decline_reason_code WHERE fact_payment_attempt.auth_status != 'approved' AND fact_payment_attempt.is_test = false GROUP BY ref_decline_reason.description ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
